{{Otheruses|Chorba}}
{{Quote|You heard what Kris said&mdash;by the time they were done 'disciplining' you on that base, they would have tortured you until your brains were mashed chorba.|Mair Koda, to Yuri Stonelaw|<ref name="TD">{{JournalCite|15|The Draw}}</ref>}}
'''Corellian chorba-root''', also known simply as '''chorba''', was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]]. It was grown in tracts across the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]], where it was [[Farmer/Legends|farmed]] by the [[Human/Legends|Humans]] living on the world. [[Arn Stonelaw|Arn]] and [[Emmi Stonelaw]] made their living as chorba farmers during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TD" /> The [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] of the plant was distilled into a potent [[Chorba fruit rum|rum]] at [[Chorba Chuggers]] on the planet [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]].<ref name="SR">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

{{Flora-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Corellian chorba-root was first mentioned in "[[The Draw]]," a short story written by [[Angela Phillips]] and published in the [[November]] [[1997]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 15|fifteenth issue]] of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine.<ref name="TD" />
